card.title: Every Compliment Raises the Bar
card.instruction: Treat each compliment as sincere admiration and a new standard you must immediately surpass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called my cake impressive. I'll add a second tier before you leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The icing is perfect already. I came for a slice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Then the second tier needs icing roses. Perfect can't just happen twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You make those beautifully. Could mine go in a box? My taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll make your rose climb the lid. You should leave with something better than beautiful.

mechanism: A receives every compliment warmly and immediately makes it the minimum standard the next cake detail must exceed.
confusable: Unlike rejecting praise, A must accept it as sincere and then raise a concrete performance demand.
comparison: S229-a upgrades a slice into a box-climbing rose; S229-b compresses a budget onto a napkin during lunch.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
